messages:
violet: Idea! Mystery Lunchbox Swap (bring a wrapped lunch, tag veg/contains-nuts) + optional 2-hour mini DnD one-shot after 6pm in Conf Room C. Low key and silly. Who's up? :bento: :dragon:

marcus: very in. i'll do vegetarian and can DM ingredient list. will probably arrive ~5:45 to set up.

diego: curious  i've never played DnD but happy to watch/join if it's newbie-friendly. what edition?

avahana: i'm down for the swap but can't stay late. can we run DnD as a short 1.5hr session with pre-gen characters?

lunchbot: Poll: "Do you want to join the DnD one-shot?" options: Yes - play, Yes - watch, No  vote with :one: :two: :three:. (poll id 12077)

marcus: voted :one: (Yes - play)

diego: voted :two: (Yes - watch)

avahana: voted :one: (Yes - play)

violet: plan: swap at 5:30 in the kitchen; Conf Room C reserved 6:00-8:00 for the one-shot (pre-gen characters + cheat-sheet). we'll stream sound for remote folks.

calendarbot: Event created: "Mystery Lunchbox Swap" 2026-04-28 17:30 - 18:00. Recurring: none.

marcus: i'll bring a small box of allergy-friendly snacks and sticky notes to label lunches. also can run the one-shot if folks want a chill adventure.

diego: sounds great. remote folks can join the stream and the watch party. can we use Jitsi? no sign-in hassle.

avahana: quick dietary note: severe peanut allergy in my family, please mark "contains-nuts" clearly.

violet: yes please label. i'll post a tiny sign-up for swap items and whether people want to play/watch: https://tiny.redwood/lunchbox-swap (placeholder)

lunchbot: Reminder set: "Mystery Lunchbox Swap + DnD" 2026-04-28 16:00 (local)

marcus: if we get >8 players we can run two one-shots in parallel. otherwise we'll keep it cozy.

diego: i'll bring extra soda and a whiteboard for initiative tracking if needed.

avahana: i'll bring simple props (dice + a foam goblet) to make it silly.

violet: awesome team. final checklist: swap on table at 5:30, labels for allergens, Conf Room C 6-8, Jitsi link posted before start. i'll pin here when links are up. :sparkles:
